channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Sick of the 'snow': 200 residents protest quarrying operation in Sungai Buloh
item.description: SUNGAI BULOH: More than 200 residents in Zon 20 here are calling for state government intervention over a long-standing quarry operation that has allegedly caused property damage and chronic dust pollution for over two decades.

item.title: WTCKL receives Asean Tourism Standards Award for third Asean MICE venue
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The World Trade Centre Kuala Lumpur (WTCKL) has achieved an international milestone after receiving the Asean Tourism Standards Award 2026–2028 for the third Asean MICE Venue (Exhibition Venue Category).

item.title: Firefighters rescue teacher weighing 350kg, safely transported to hospital
item.description: ALOR GAJAH: Firefighters assisted a 40-year-old teacher, weighing about 350kg, who was severely incapacitated at home due to medical conditions, at Taman Sri Gemilan, Kuala Sungai Baru, early this morning.

item.title: Wei Chong-Kai Wun seek magic touch to beat Indonesian bogey pair
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: National men’s doubles coach Herry IP is seeking psychological and technical solutions to help Man Wei Chong-Tee Kai Wun overcome their losing streak against Indonesia’s Sabar Karyaman-Moh Reza Isfahani.

item.title: Forest face Fenerbahce, Celtic draw Stuttgart in Europa League play-offs
item.description: PARIS: Nottingham Forest face a daunting trip to Istanbul after being drawn Friday to play Fenerbahce in the knockout phase play-offs of the Europa League, while Celtic must take on German giants VfB Stuttgart.

item.title: Proposal to go solo if PN issues persist not arrogance, says Pas man
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Pas spiritual leader Datuk Hashim Jasin’s suggestion for the party to contest solo if internal Perikatan Nasional (PN) crises remain unresolved is not an act of arrogance or a move to sever ties.

item.title: Carrick calls for calm after flying start to Man Utd reign
item.description: LONDON: Michael Carrick has warned his Manchester United players not to get carried away by their impressive wins against Manchester City and Arsenal ahead of their match against Fulham on Sunday.

item.title: Goretzka to leave Bayern Munich at end of season
item.description: MUNICH: German international Leon Goretzka will leave Bayern Munich at the end of his contract this summer, the midfielder announced on Friday.

item.title: Frank insists Spurs owners are 'super committed'
item.description: LONDON: Thomas Frank said Tottenham’s much-maligned owners are “super committed” to the club despite their struggle to make signings during the January transfer window.

item.title: West Ham match is 'biggest game' for Chelsea: Rosenior
item.description: LONDON: Liam Rosenior labelled Chelsea’s London derby against West Ham on Saturday as their biggest game of the season, saying he would “find out so much” about his players.
